verdict.rationale: LibreChat is self-hosted (Docker/npm/Helm) so data including any memory store resides on the operator's own infrastructure, and a dedicated 'User Memory' feature page exists, but the evidence never describes the storage format, nor any UI/API to inspect, edit, or delete individual memory entries. Missing for 10: content of the memory docs showing edit/delete controls, confirmation the memory store uses an open/portable format (vs. opaque MongoDB documents), and any independent/hands-on confirmation of user-level memory management.
